options.name: advbase
options.description: The base frequency that this machine will advertise.

options.name: advskew
options.description: The frequency skew that this machine will advertise.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: carp_mode
options.description: The CARP mode to use for this virtual IP. Please note this field is exclusive to pfSense Plus and has no effect on CE.

options.name: carp_peer
options.description: The IP address of the CARP peer. Please note this field is exclusive to pfSense Plus and has no effect on CE.

options.name: descr
options.description: A description for administrative reference

options.name: interface
options.description: The interface this virtual IP will apply to.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mode
options.description: The virtual IP mode to use for this virtual IP.

options.name: noexpand
options.description: Disable expansion of this entry into IPs on NAT lists (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 expands to 256 entries.)

options.name: password
options.description: The VHID group password shared by all CARP members.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: subnet
options.description: The address for this virtual IP.

options.name: subnet_bits
options.description: The subnet bits for this virtual IP. For `proxyarp` and `other` virtual IPs, this value specifies a block of many IP address. For all other virtual IP modes, this specifies the subnet mask

options.name: type
options.description: The virtual IP scope type. The `network` option is only applicable to the `proxyarp` and `other` virtual IP modes.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: vhid
options.description: The VHID group that the machines will share.
